markers.to: 01: III → I; one-way drop behind Verdan into the river

uncertain: Dashed outlines in III show the known Pythas–Skum–upper cavern connection, not a verified rendering of every Vanilla maze junction. Exact bends and side passages need an in-game survey.
The dashed arrow in II marks the Cobrahn return drop; its exact ledge geometry is unresolved.
Marker 1 represents the upper-bank spawn area, not a fixed Lady Anacondra spawn. Marker 3 represents the river patrol, not a fixed Kresh spawn.
Deviate Faerie Dragon is not plotted: reliable Vanilla spawn positions are still required.
notes: Only the instanced dungeon is shown.
Boss numbers follow a common full-clear route; Kresh may be encountered earlier.
Leaders of the Fang objectives are bosses 1, 2, 4 and 6.
Serpentbloom and creature-drop objectives are distributed; no fixed gathering points are asserted.
